title: Gitea console is reachable without authentication
description: The Gitea web interface is served without authentication in a way that exposes the instance rather than the intended sign-in flow. Gitea carries repositories, issues, webhooks and the instance administration screens.
remediation: Disable open registration, require the instance login for browsing if the code is private, and keep the administration routes off the public host.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the Gitea console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · Gitea</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
